decisions.choice: worked righteousness: ruled with justice, did what was right as leaders
decisions.reason: δικαιοσύνην usually means righteousness; with "worked" and following "conquered kingdoms" it most likely means the just rule of judges and kings (2 Samuel 8:15, David "did justice and righteousness for all his people"; 1 Samuel 12:3-4, Samuel).

decisions.choice: obtained promises: received particular things God had promised, though not the final promise (11:39)
decisions.reason: They saw God keep particular promises: victory, the land (Joshua 21:43-45), the kingdom promised to David (2 Samuel 7). Yet 11:39 says none of them received "the promise", the final inheritance. The plural here and the singular there make the distinction.

Shut the mouths of lions: Daniel (Daniel 6:22; compare Samson, Judges 14:5-6, and David, 1 Samuel 17:34-37). Quenched the power of fire: Daniel's three friends (Daniel 3:19-27). Escaped the edge of the sword: David from Saul (1 Samuel 18-19), Elijah (1 Kings 19:1-3), Jeremiah (Jeremiah 26:24). Made strong out of weakness: Samson (Judges 16:28-30), Hezekiah (Isaiah 38). Turned back foreign armies: Gideon (Judges 7), Jonathan and David (1 Samuel 14; 17). The list may also have in view the Maccabean wars (1 Maccabees).

decisions.choice: the mouths of the sword: the sword's edge
decisions.reason: A Hebrew way of speaking (the "mouth" of the sword, Genesis 34:26), carried into Greek. It also echoes the "mouths of lions" just before.

decisions.choice: ruled with justice; ruled fairly
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense chosen in the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: They were weak, but God made them strong
alternatives: were made strong out of weakness
decisions.reason: The passive "were made strong" implies that God gave the strength; Readable says so.

decisions.choice: bocas de espada (L); filo de la espada (B); morir a espada (R)
alternatives: filo de espada at every level
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom (m7), so its echo of "bocas de leones" just before can be seen. Balanced uses the ordinary Spanish expression for the same thing, the edge of the sword.

decisions.choice: walitenda haki (L); walitawala kwa haki (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Haki" means both righteousness and justice, so Swahili keeps its key word for righteousness at every level while saying, as the meaning decision does (m4), that they ruled with justice.

decisions.choice: "bouches ... bouches" (L); "la gueule des lions ... le tranchant de l’épée" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the repeated Greek word for the lions’ mouths and the sword’s "mouths" (m7), as the English Literal does. Balanced and Readable use the natural French words for an animal’s mouth and a blade’s edge.

decisions.choice: "Ghê-đê-ôn, Ba-rác, Sam-sôn, Giép-thê, Sa-mu-ên"
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms of the judges' and prophet's names.

decisions.choice: "thực thi sự công chính" (L); "cai trị theo lẽ công chính" (B); "cai trị cách công bằng" (R)
decisions.reason: To work righteousness is to rule with justice (m4). Literal and Balanced keep the key word "công chính"; Readable says "công bằng" (fairly), as the English Readable says "fairly".

decisions.choice: the names in their Protestant Korean forms: 기드온, 바락, 삼손, 입다, 다윗, 사무엘, as through the chapter (아벨, 가인, 에녹, 노아, 사라, 이삭, 야곱, 에서, 요셉, 라합, 여리고, 홍해)
alternatives: the transliterations of the Common Translation
decisions.reason: As the Korean style guide sets (section 5) for names. The writer's "I" is "나", as in the letter's other first-person words; Korean does not mark that the writer is a man (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: das bocas [da] espada (L); do fio da espada (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom "mouths of the sword", which echoes "bocas de leões" just before (m7); Balanced uses the Portuguese idiom for the sword's edge, "o fio da espada".

decisions.choice: "गिदोन", "बाराक", "शिमशोन", "यिप्तह", "शमूएल"
decisions.reason: The established Hindi Bible forms of the names.

decisions.choice: "भविष्यद्वक्ताओं" (L, B); "नबियों" (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's key term for prophet.

decisions.choice: Гедеон, Варак, Самсон, Иеффай, Самуил
decisions.reason: The traditional Russian Bible forms of the names, as the style guide asks for proper names.

decisions.choice: "Гедеон, Варак, Самсон, Єфтай, Самуїл"
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms of the names, so that Judges and Samuel match; "Варак" is the established Ukrainian Bible form and is settled here for the book.

decisions.choice: Names "ギデオン", "バラク", "サムソン", "エフタ", "サムエル"
decisions.reason: Conventional Japanese forms of the judges' and prophet's names, not in the style guide's list.

decisions.choice: "剣の刃" at every level for "the mouths of the sword"
decisions.reason: An idiom for the sword's edge (meaning decision); a literal "剣の口" would not be understood in Japanese, so even Literal gives the sense.

source.text: ἔλαβον γυναῖκες ἐξ ἀναστάσεως τοὺς νεκροὺς αὐτῶν· ἄλλοι δὲ ἐτυμπανίσθησαν, οὐ προσδεξάμενοι τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν, ἵνα κρείττονος ἀναστάσεως τύχωσιν·

records.literal_gloss: Received women by resurrection the dead of them; others but were tortured, not having accepted the release, so that a better resurrection they might obtain;

en.L: Women received their dead by resurrection; and others were tortured, not having accepted release, so that they might obtain a better resurrection.
en.B: Women had their dead given back to them, raised to life. Others were tortured and beaten, and they would not accept freedom, because they wanted to obtain a better resurrection.
en.R: Some women had their dead family members raised back to life. Other people were tortured. They refused to give up their faith in order to be set free, because they wanted to be raised to a better life when God raises the dead.

es.L: Mujeres recibieron a sus muertos por resurrección; y otros fueron torturados, no habiendo aceptado la liberación, a fin de obtener una resurrección mejor.
es.B: Hubo mujeres que recibieron de vuelta a sus muertos, resucitados. Otros fueron torturados a golpes y no quisieron aceptar la libertad, porque deseaban alcanzar una resurrección mejor.
es.R: Algunas mujeres recibieron de nuevo con vida a sus familiares muertos. Otras personas fueron torturadas. Se negaron a abandonar su fe para quedar libres, porque querían ser levantadas a una vida mejor cuando Dios resucite a los muertos.

fr.L: Des femmes reçurent leurs morts par résurrection ; et d’autres furent torturés, n’ayant pas accepté la délivrance, afin d’atteindre une résurrection meilleure.
fr.B: Des femmes se virent rendre leurs morts, ramenés à la vie. D’autres furent torturés et roués de coups, et ils refusèrent la libération, parce qu’ils voulaient accéder à une résurrection meilleure.
fr.R: Certaines femmes ont vu des membres de leur famille revenir de la mort à la vie. D’autres personnes ont été torturées. Elles ont refusé de renoncer à leur foi pour être libérées, parce qu’elles voulaient être relevées pour une vie meilleure quand Dieu ressuscitera les morts.

sw.L: Wanawake waliwapokea wafu wao kwa ufufuo; na wengine waliteswa, bila kukubali kufunguliwa, ili wapate ufufuo ulio bora zaidi.
sw.B: Wanawake walirudishiwa wafu wao, wakiwa wamefufuliwa. Wengine waliteswa na kupigwa, nao hawakukubali kuachiliwa huru, kwa sababu walitaka kupata ufufuo ulio bora zaidi.
sw.R: Wanawake fulani waliwapata ndugu zao waliokufa wakiwa wamefufuliwa na kurudi uzimani. Watu wengine waliteswa. Walikataa kuiacha imani yao ili waachiliwe huru, kwa sababu walitaka kufufuliwa kwenye uzima ulio bora zaidi wakati Mungu atakapowafufua wafu.

vi.L: Có những người đàn bà đã nhận lại người thân đã chết của mình nhờ sự sống lại; còn những người khác thì bị tra tấn, không chịu nhận sự giải thoát, để được một sự sống lại tốt hơn.
vi.B: Có những người phụ nữ đã được nhận lại người thân đã chết của mình, được sống lại. Những người khác thì bị tra tấn đánh đập, nhưng không chịu nhận sự tự do, vì họ muốn được một sự sống lại tốt hơn.
vi.R: Có những người phụ nữ đã nhận lại người nhà đã chết của mình, được Đức Chúa Trời khiến cho sống lại. Những người khác thì bị tra tấn. Họ không chịu chối bỏ đức tin để được thả ra, vì họ muốn được sống lại để vào một sự sống tốt hơn khi Đức Chúa Trời khiến người chết sống lại.

ko.L: 여자들은 자기의 죽은 사람들을 부활로 다시 받았습니다. 그리고 다른 사람들은 더 나은 부활을 얻으려고 풀려나기를 거부하고 고문을 받았습니다.
ko.B: 여자들은 죽은 가족을 다시 살아난 모습으로 돌려받았습니다. 또 다른 사람들은 고문을 받으면서도 풀려나기를 거부했습니다. 더 나은 부활을 얻기를 바랐기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 어떤 여자들은 죽은 가족이 다시 살아나서 그들을 돌려받았습니다. 다른 사람들은 고문을 당했습니다. 그들은 풀려나려고 믿음을 버리기를 거부했습니다. 하나님께서 죽은 사람들을 살리실 때 더 좋은 삶으로 살아나기를 바랐기 때문입니다.

pt.L: Mulheres receberam os seus mortos por ressurreição; e outros foram torturados, não aceitando a libertação, para alcançarem uma ressurreição melhor.
pt.B: Mulheres receberam de volta os seus mortos, ressuscitados. Outros foram torturados e espancados, e não aceitaram ser libertados, porque queriam alcançar uma ressurreição melhor.
pt.R: Algumas mulheres tiveram os seus familiares mortos trazidos de volta à vida. Outras pessoas foram torturadas. Elas se recusaram a abandonar a fé para serem libertadas, porque queriam ressuscitar para uma vida melhor quando Deus ressuscitar os mortos.

am.L: ሴቶች የሞቱባቸውን በትንሣኤ መልሰው አገኙ፤ ሌሎች ግን የተሻለ ትንሣኤ ያገኙ ዘንድ መለቀቅን እምቢ ብለው ተሠቃዩ።
am.B: ሴቶች የሞቱባቸው ከሞት ተነሥተው ተመለሱላቸው። ሌሎች ደግሞ ተደብድበው ተሠቃዩ፤ የተሻለ ትንሣኤ ለማግኘት ስለ ፈለጉ መፈታትን አልተቀበሉም።
am.R: አንዳንድ ሴቶች የሞቱባቸው የቤተ ሰብ አባሎቻቸው ከሞት ተነሥተው ተመለሱላቸው። ሌሎች ሰዎች ደግሞ ተሠቃዩ። ነፃ ለመውጣት ሲሉ እምነታቸውን ለመተው እምቢ አሉ፤ ምክንያቱም እግዚአብሔር ሙታንን በሚያስነሣበት ጊዜ ወደ ተሻለ ሕይወት ለመነሣት ፈለጉ።

hi.L: स्त्रियों ने अपने मरे हुओं को फिर जीवित पाया; और दूसरे लोग यातना देकर मारे गए, और उन्होंने छुटकारा स्वीकार न किया, ताकि उत्तम पुनरुत्थान पाएँ।
hi.B: स्त्रियों ने अपने मरे हुओं को पुनरुत्थान के द्वारा फिर से पाया। दूसरों को यातनाएँ दी गईं और पीटा गया, और उन्होंने छुटकारा स्वीकार न किया, क्योंकि वे उत्तम पुनरुत्थान पाना चाहते थे।
hi.R: कुछ स्त्रियों के परिवार के मरे हुए लोग फिर से जीवित कर दिए गए। दूसरे लोगों को यातनाएँ दी गईं। उन्होंने छूटने के लिए अपना विश्वास छोड़ने से इनकार किया, क्योंकि वे चाहते थे कि जब परमेश्वर मरे हुओं को जिलाएँ, तब उन्हें एक बढ़कर जीवन मिले।

ru.L: Жёны получали своих умерших через воскресение; а другие были замучены, не приняв освобождения, чтобы получить лучшее воскресение.
ru.B: Женщинам возвращали их умерших, воскрешённых к жизни. Другие претерпели пытки и избиения и не приняли освобождения, потому что хотели получить лучшее воскресение.
ru.R: Некоторым женщинам вернули их умерших близких, воскресив их к жизни. Других людей пытали. Они отказались отречься от веры, чтобы их отпустили, потому что хотели воскреснуть к лучшей жизни, когда Бог воскресит мёртвых.

uk.L: Жінки отримали своїх мертвих через воскресіння; а інших катували, і вони не прийняли визволення, щоб отримати краще воскресіння;
uk.B: Жінкам поверталися їхні мертві, воскреслі до життя. Інших катували й били, і вони не погоджувалися на визволення, бо хотіли здобути краще воскресіння.
uk.R: Деякі жінки отримали назад своїх померлих рідних, яких Бог повернув до життя. Інших людей катували. Вони відмовилися зректися віри, щоб їх відпустили, бо хотіли воскреснути до кращого життя, коли Бог воскресить мертвих.

ja.L: 女たちは、自分たちの死者を復活によって受け取りました。しかし、ほかの者たちは、解放を受け入れずに拷問を受けました。さらに良い復活を得るためです。
ja.B: 女たちは、死んだ家族をよみがえらせてもらい、返してもらいました。ほかの人々は、拷問にかけられて打たれましたが、釈放を受け入れようとはしませんでした。さらに良い復活にあずかりたいと願ったからです。
ja.R: ある女の人たちは、死んだ家族を生き返らせてもらいました。ほかの人たちは、ひどい拷問を受けました。信仰を捨てれば自由にしてもらえたのに、彼らはそれを拒みました。神が死んだ人々をよみがえらせるときに、もっと良い命へとよみがえりたいと願ったからです。

decisions.reason: Elijah raised the son of the widow of Zarephath and gave him back to his mother (1 Kings 17:23), and Elisha raised the son of the Shunammite woman (2 Kings 4:36-37).

2 Maccabees, a Jewish book written in Greek, found in the Greek Old Testament though not in the Hebrew Bible, tells of the elderly Eleazar, who went to the place of torture rather than eat forbidden food (2 Maccabees 6:19, 28), and of seven brothers and their mother, who were tortured to death under King Antiochus IV (about 167 BC). They were offered their freedom if they gave up God's law (7:24), and they died hoping that God would raise them up to everlasting life (7:9, 14, 23).

decisions.choice: were tortured: beaten while stretched on a frame
decisions.reason: τυμπανίζω comes from a word for a drum, and means to torture someone stretched on a frame and beaten. Such torture often ended in death, and the author may mean that they died.

decisions.choice: release: being set free from the torture, on the condition of giving up their faith
decisions.reason: ἀπολύτρωσις usually means redemption or release by payment. Here it is the release the torturers offered, which those tortured would not accept.

decisions.choice: a better resurrection: rising to everlasting life, better than a return to this life
decisions.reason: The women at the start of the verse received their dead back to mortal life; those who were tortured hoped for the resurrection to the life that does not end (6:2; Daniel 12:2).

decisions.choice: refused to give up their faith in order to be set free; when God raises the dead
decisions.reason: Readable says what release would have cost them, following 2 Maccabees 7:24, and what the better resurrection is. The Greek implies these but does not say them.

decisions.choice: "ተሠቃዩ" (were tortured) at Literal and Readable; "ተደብድበው ተሠቃዩ" (were beaten and tortured) at Balanced
decisions.reason: The Greek verb names torture by beating on a frame; Amharic has no single word for it, and flogging comes in the next verse with its own word.

source.text: ἕτεροι δὲ ἐμπαιγμῶν καὶ μαστίγων πεῖραν ἔλαβον, ἔτι δὲ δεσμῶν καὶ φυλακῆς·

records.literal_gloss: Others and of mockings and of floggings trial received, still and of chains and of prison;

en.L: And others received [the] trial of mockings and floggings, and still more of chains and prison.
en.B: Others went through mockery and the lash, and beyond that, chains and prison cells.
en.R: Others were laughed at and beaten with whips. Some were even put in chains and thrown into prison.

es.L: Y otros recibieron prueba de burlas y de azotes, y más aún de cadenas y de cárcel.
es.B: Otros pasaron por burlas y latigazos, y además por cadenas y celdas de prisión.
es.R: Otros sufrieron burlas y golpes de látigo. Algunos hasta fueron encadenados y echados en la cárcel.

fr.L: Et d’autres reçurent l’épreuve de moqueries et de coups de fouet, et plus encore de chaînes et de prison.
fr.B: D’autres connurent les railleries et le fouet, et en plus les chaînes et les cachots.
fr.R: D’autres ont été tournés en ridicule et frappés à coups de fouet. Certains ont même été enchaînés et jetés en prison.

sw.L: Na wengine walipata majaribu ya dhihaka na mijeledi, na zaidi ya hayo ya minyororo na gereza.
sw.B: Wengine walipitia dhihaka na mapigo ya mijeledi, na zaidi ya hayo, minyororo na vifungo gerezani.
sw.R: Wengine walichekwa na kupigwa kwa mijeledi. Wengine hata walifungwa minyororo na kutupwa gerezani.

vi.L: Và những người khác chịu thử thách bằng sự nhạo báng và roi vọt, thậm chí còn bằng xiềng xích và lao tù.
vi.B: Những người khác đã chịu sự chế nhạo và roi vọt, hơn nữa, còn bị xiềng xích và giam vào ngục tối.
vi.R: Những người khác bị chế giễu và bị đánh bằng roi. Có người còn bị xiềng xích và bị ném vào tù.

ko.L: 또 다른 사람들은 조롱과 채찍질을 겪었고, 더 나아가 결박과 투옥을 겪었습니다.
ko.B: 또 다른 사람들은 조롱과 채찍질을 당했고, 쇠사슬에 묶여 감옥에 갇히기까지 했습니다.
ko.R: 또 다른 사람들은 비웃음을 받고 채찍으로 맞았습니다. 어떤 사람들은 쇠사슬에 묶여 감옥에 갇히기까지 했습니다.

pt.L: E outros passaram pela prova de escárnios e açoites, e ainda de cadeias e prisão.
pt.B: Outros enfrentaram zombarias e chicotadas, e além disso correntes e celas de prisão.
pt.R: Outros foram ridicularizados e espancados com chicotes. Alguns foram até acorrentados e jogados na prisão.

am.L: ሌሎችም የመዘበትንና የግርፋትን፣ ከዚህም በላይ የሰንሰለትንና የወኅኒን ፈተና ተቀበሉ።
am.B: ሌሎች መዘበቻና ግርፋት፣ ከዚህም በላይ ሰንሰለትና እስር ቤት ደረሰባቸው።
am.R: ሌሎች ሰዎች ተሳለቁባቸው፤ በጅራፍም ተገረፉ። አንዳንዶቹም በሰንሰለት ታስረው ወደ እስር ቤት ተጣሉ።

hi.L: और दूसरों ने ठट्ठों और कोड़ों की, और इससे भी बढ़कर बेड़ियों और क़ैद की परख सही।
hi.B: दूसरों ने उपहास और कोड़े सहे, और इससे भी बढ़कर, ज़ंजीरें और जेल की कोठरियाँ।
hi.R: दूसरों की हँसी उड़ाई गई और उन्हें कोड़ों से पीटा गया। कुछ को ज़ंजीरों में बाँधकर जेल में भी डाल दिया गया।

ru.L: А другие испытали поругания и бичевания, а ещё и оковы и темницу.
ru.B: Другие перенесли насмешки и бичи, а сверх того оковы и тюрьмы.
ru.R: Над другими смеялись и били их плетями. Некоторых даже заковывали в цепи и бросали в тюрьму.

uk.L: А інші зазнали глузувань і бичувань, ба навіть кайданів і вʼязниці.
uk.B: Інші зазнали знущань і бичів, а ще й кайданів та вʼязниці.
uk.R: З інших сміялися і били їх батогами. Декого навіть закували в кайдани і кинули до вʼязниці.

ja.L: また、ほかの者たちは、あざけりとむち打ちの試みを受け、さらに鎖と牢獄の[試みを受けました]。
ja.B: また、ほかの人々は、あざけられ、むちで打たれ、さらには鎖につながれ、牢に入れられました。
ja.R: ほかの人たちは、笑い者にされ、むちで打たれました。鎖につながれて、牢屋に入れられた人たちさえいました。

decisions.choice: Jeremiah 20:2; 37:15; 1 Kings 22:24-27; 2 Chronicles 36:16
decisions.reason: Jeremiah was beaten and put in the stocks and later imprisoned (Jeremiah 20:2; 37:15); Micaiah was struck and put in prison (1 Kings 22:24-27); Israel "mocked the messengers of God" (2 Chronicles 36:16). In 2 Maccabees 7:7, 10 the brothers are mocked before they are tortured.

decisions.choice: received trial of: experienced, went through
decisions.reason: πεῖραν ἔλαβον ("to take a trial of") means to experience something; the same phrase is used of the Egyptians in 11:29, who "made trial" of the sea.

source.text: ἐλιθάσθησαν, ἐπρίσθησαν, ἐν φόνῳ μαχαίρης ἀπέθανον, περιῆλθον ἐν μηλωταῖς, ἐν αἰγείοις δέρμασιν, ὑστερούμενοι, θλιβόμενοι, κακουχούμενοι, ὧν οὐκ ἦν ἄξιος ὁ κόσμος ἐπὶ ἐρημίαις πλανώμενοι καὶ ὄρεσι καὶ σπηλαίοις καὶ ταῖς ὀπαῖς τῆς γῆς·

records.literal_gloss: They were stoned, they were sawn in two, by murder of sword they died, they went around in sheepskins, in goat skins, being in need, being oppressed, being mistreated, \v 38 of whom not was worthy the world, in deserts wandering and mountains and caves and the holes of the earth.

en.L: They were stoned, they were sawn in two, they died by murder of [the] sword; they went around in sheepskins, in goat skins, being in need, being oppressed, being mistreated \v 38 (of whom the world was not worthy), wandering in deserts and mountains and caves and the holes of the earth.
en.B: They were stoned, sawn in two, cut down by the sword. They roamed about wearing the skins of sheep and goats, lacking everything, oppressed, treated cruelly. \v 38 The world did not deserve such people. They wandered over deserts and mountains, and sheltered in caves and in holes in the earth.
en.R: Some were killed by having stones thrown at them. Some were cut in two with a saw. Some were killed with swords. Some went from place to place wearing only the skins of sheep and goats. They were poor, they suffered much, and people treated them cruelly. \v 38 The world was not worthy of such people. They wandered in deserts and mountains. They had to hide in caves and in pits dug in the earth.

es.L: Fueron apedreados, fueron aserrados, murieron por asesinato de espada; anduvieron de un lado a otro en pieles de oveja, en pieles de cabra, padeciendo necesidad, siendo oprimidos, siendo maltratados \v 38 (de los cuales el mundo no era digno), andando errantes por desiertos y montes y cuevas y los agujeros de la tierra.
es.B: Fueron apedreados, aserrados por la mitad, abatidos a espada. Iban de un lado a otro vestidos con pieles de oveja y de cabra, privados de todo, oprimidos, tratados con crueldad. \v 38 El mundo no merecía a personas así. Anduvieron errantes por desiertos y montes, y se refugiaron en cuevas y en agujeros de la tierra.
es.R: A algunos los mataron a pedradas. A algunos los cortaron en dos con una sierra. A algunos los mataron con la espada. Algunos iban de un lugar a otro vestidos solo con pieles de ovejas y de cabras. Eran pobres, sufrían mucho y la gente los trataba con crueldad. \v 38 El mundo no era digno de personas como ellas. Andaban sin rumbo por desiertos y montañas. Tuvieron que esconderse en cuevas y en hoyos cavados en la tierra.

fr.L: Ils furent lapidés, ils furent sciés, ils moururent par [le] meurtre de [l’]épée ; ils allèrent de lieu en lieu dans des peaux de mouton, dans des peaux de chèvre, dans le besoin, opprimés, maltraités \v 38 (dont le monde n’était pas digne), errant dans des déserts et des montagnes et des cavernes et les trous de la terre.
fr.B: Ils furent lapidés, sciés en deux, abattus par l’épée. Ils allaient d’un endroit à l’autre, couverts de peaux de moutons et de chèvres, privés de tout, opprimés, traités avec cruauté. \v 38 Le monde ne méritait pas des gens comme eux. Ils errèrent dans les déserts et les montagnes, et s’abritèrent dans des cavernes et des trous de la terre.
fr.R: Certains ont été tués à coups de pierres. D’autres ont été coupés en deux avec une scie. D’autres encore ont été tués avec l’épée. Certains allaient d’un endroit à l’autre, habillés seulement de peaux de moutons et de chèvres. Ils étaient pauvres, ils souffraient beaucoup, et on les traitait avec cruauté. \v 38 Le monde n’était pas digne de gens comme eux. Ils ont erré dans les déserts et les montagnes. Ils ont dû se cacher dans des grottes et dans des trous creusés dans la terre.

sw.L: Walipigwa mawe, walipasuliwa vipande viwili, walikufa kwa kuuawa kwa upanga; walitembea huku na huko wakiwa wamevaa ngozi za kondoo, ngozi za mbuzi, wakiwa wahitaji, wakionewa, wakitendewa mabaya \v 38 (ambao ulimwengu haukustahili kuwa nao), wakitangatanga katika majangwa na milima na mapango na mashimo ya ardhi.
sw.B: Walipigwa mawe, walipasuliwa vipande viwili, waliuawa kwa upanga. Walizunguka wakiwa wamevaa ngozi za kondoo na za mbuzi, wakikosa kila kitu, wakionewa na kutendewa kikatili. \v 38 Ulimwengu haukustahili kuwa na watu wa namna hiyo. Walitangatanga katika majangwa na milima, wakajificha katika mapango na mashimo ardhini.
sw.R: Wengine waliuawa kwa kupigwa mawe. Wengine walikatwa vipande viwili kwa msumeno. Wengine waliuawa kwa upanga. Wengine walihama mahali hadi mahali wakiwa wamevaa ngozi za kondoo na za mbuzi tu. Walikuwa maskini, waliteseka sana, na watu waliwatendea kikatili. \v 38 Ulimwengu haukustahili kuwa na watu wa namna hiyo. Walitangatanga majangwani na milimani. Ilibidi wajifiche katika mapango na katika mashimo yaliyochimbwa ardhini.

vi.L: Họ bị ném đá, bị cưa làm hai, bị giết bằng gươm; họ lang thang mặc da chiên, da dê, bị thiếu thốn, bị áp bức, bị ngược đãi \v 38 (là những người mà thế gian không xứng đáng), lưu lạc trong các hoang mạc và núi non, hang động và hầm hố trong lòng đất.
vi.B: Họ bị ném đá, bị cưa làm hai, bị giết bằng gươm. Họ đi lang thang, mặc da chiên và da dê, thiếu thốn đủ thứ, bị áp bức, bị ngược đãi. \v 38 Thế gian không xứng đáng có những người như thế. Họ lưu lạc khắp các hoang mạc và núi non, trú ẩn trong các hang động và hầm hố trong lòng đất.
vi.R: Có người bị ném đá cho đến chết. Có người bị cưa làm hai. Có người bị giết bằng gươm. Có người đi hết nơi này đến nơi khác, chỉ mặc da chiên và da dê. Họ nghèo khổ, chịu nhiều đau khổ, và bị người ta đối xử tàn ác. \v 38 Thế gian không xứng đáng có những người như thế. Họ đi lang thang trong các hoang mạc và núi non. Họ phải ẩn mình trong các hang động và các hố đào trong lòng đất.

ko.L: 그들은 돌에 맞고, 톱으로 켜지고, 칼에 죽임을 당하고, 양가죽과 염소 가죽을 두르고 떠돌아다니며, 궁핍하고, 억눌리고, 학대를 받았습니다. \v 38 (세상은 그들을 받을 자격이 없었습니다.) 그들은 광야와 산과 동굴과 땅굴을 헤매었습니다.
ko.B: 그들은 돌에 맞고, 톱으로 켜지고, 칼에 맞아 죽었습니다. 그들은 양과 염소의 가죽을 걸치고 떠돌아다니며, 모든 것이 궁핍했고, 억눌리고, 학대를 받았습니다. \v 38 세상은 이런 사람들을 받을 자격이 없었습니다. 그들은 광야와 산을 헤매고, 동굴과 땅굴에 숨어 지냈습니다.
ko.R: 어떤 사람들은 돌에 맞아 죽었습니다. 어떤 사람들은 톱으로 몸이 둘로 잘렸습니다. 어떤 사람들은 칼에 맞아 죽었습니다. 어떤 사람들은 양과 염소의 가죽만 걸치고 이곳저곳으로 떠돌아다녔습니다. 그들은 가난했고, 많은 고통을 겪었으며, 사람들은 그들을 잔인하게 대했습니다. \v 38 세상은 이런 사람들을 받을 자격이 없었습니다. 그들은 광야와 산을 떠돌아다녔습니다. 그들은 동굴과 땅에 판 구덩이에 숨어야 했습니다.

pt.L: Foram apedrejados, foram serrados ao meio, morreram assassinados à espada; andaram de um lado para outro em peles de ovelha, em peles de cabra, passando necessidade, oprimidos, maltratados \v 38 (dos quais o mundo não era digno), vagando por desertos e montes e cavernas e as covas da terra.
pt.B: Foram apedrejados, serrados ao meio, mortos a fio de espada. Andaram por toda parte vestidos com peles de ovelhas e de cabras, sem nada, oprimidos, tratados com crueldade. \v 38 O mundo não merecia gente assim. Andaram errantes por desertos e montes e se abrigaram em cavernas e em buracos na terra.
pt.R: Alguns foram mortos a pedradas. Alguns foram cortados ao meio com uma serra. Alguns foram mortos à espada. Alguns andavam de um lugar para outro vestidos só com peles de ovelhas e de cabras. Eram pobres, sofriam muito, e as pessoas os tratavam com crueldade. \v 38 O mundo não era digno de pessoas assim. Eles vagavam por desertos e montanhas. Tinham de se esconder em cavernas e em buracos cavados na terra.

am.L: በድንጋይ ተወገሩ፤ በመጋዝ ለሁለት ተሰነጠቁ፤ በሰይፍ ተገድለው ሞቱ፤ እየተቸገሩ፣ እየተጨነቁ፣ እየተንገላቱ የበግና የፍየል ቆዳ ለብሰው ዞሩ፤ \v 38 (ዓለም የማይገባቸው ነበሩ፤) በምድረ በዳና በተራሮች፣ በዋሻዎችና በምድር ጉድጓዶች እየተንከራተቱ [ኖሩ]።
am.B: በድንጋይ ተወገሩ፤ በመጋዝ ለሁለት ተሰነጠቁ፤ በሰይፍ ተገደሉ። የበግና የፍየል ቆዳ ለብሰው ተንከራተቱ፤ ሁሉን አጥተው፣ ተጨቁነውና ተንገላተው ኖሩ። \v 38 ዓለም እንደነዚህ ያሉትን ሰዎች አይገባውም ነበር። በምድረ በዳና በተራሮች ላይ ተንከራተቱ፤ በዋሻዎችና በምድር ጉድጓዶችም ተጠለሉ።
am.R: አንዳንዶቹ በድንጋይ ተወግረው ተገደሉ። አንዳንዶቹ በመጋዝ ለሁለት ተቆረጡ። አንዳንዶቹ በሰይፍ ተገደሉ። አንዳንዶቹ የበግና የፍየል ቆዳ ብቻ ለብሰው ከቦታ ወደ ቦታ ተዘዋወሩ። ድሆች ነበሩ፤ ብዙ መከራ ተቀበሉ፤ ሰዎችም በጭካኔ አንገላቷቸው። \v 38 ዓለም እንደነዚህ ያሉትን ሰዎች አይገባውም ነበር። በምድረ በዳና በተራሮች ተንከራተቱ። በዋሻዎችና በምድር ውስጥ በተቆፈሩ ጉድጓዶች ለመደበቅ ተገደዱ።

hi.L: वे पथराव किए गए, आरे से चीरे गए, तलवार से मारे गए; वे भेड़ों और बकरियों की खालें ओढ़े हुए, कंगाली में, क्लेश में, और दुःख सहते हुए इधर-उधर मारे-मारे फिरे \v 38 (संसार उनके योग्य न था), और निर्जन स्थानों और पहाड़ों और गुफाओं और धरती की दरारों में भटकते रहे।
hi.B: उन पर पथराव किया गया, वे आरे से चीरे गए, तलवार से मार डाले गए। वे भेड़ों और बकरियों की खालें पहने इधर-उधर घूमते रहे, सब बातों की घटी में, सताए हुए और दुर्व्यवहार सहते हुए। \v 38 संसार ऐसे लोगों के योग्य न था। वे निर्जन स्थानों और पहाड़ों में भटकते रहे, और गुफाओं और धरती के गड्ढों में छिपे रहे।
hi.R: कुछ लोगों को पत्थरों से मार डाला गया। कुछ को आरे से दो टुकड़ों में चीर दिया गया। कुछ को तलवार से मार डाला गया। कुछ केवल भेड़ों और बकरियों की खालें पहनकर जगह-जगह घूमते रहे। वे ग़रीब थे, उन्होंने बहुत दुःख उठाए, और लोगों ने उनके साथ क्रूर व्यवहार किया। \v 38 संसार ऐसे लोगों के योग्य नहीं था। वे सुनसान इलाक़ों और पहाड़ों में भटकते रहे। उन्हें गुफाओं में और धरती में खोदे गए गड्ढों में छिपना पड़ा।

ru.L: Были побиты камнями, были перепилены, умерли от убийства мечом; скитались в овечьих шкурах, в козьих шкурах, терпя нужду, угнетаемые, озлобляемые \v 38 (те, кого не был достоин мир), блуждая по пустыням и горам, и пещерам, и ущельям земли.
ru.B: Их побивали камнями, перепиливали надвое, убивали мечом. Они скитались в овечьих и козьих шкурах, терпя во всём нужду, угнетение и жестокость. \v 38 Мир не был достоин их. Они бродили по пустыням и горам и укрывались в пещерах и расщелинах земли.
ru.R: Некоторых убили, забросав камнями. Некоторых распилили пилой надвое. Некоторых убили мечом. Некоторые ходили с места на место, одетые лишь в шкуры овец и коз. Они были бедны, много страдали, и люди жестоко с ними обращались. \v 38 Мир не был достоин таких людей. Они скитались по пустыням и горам. Им приходилось прятаться в пещерах и ямах в земле.

uk.L: Їх каменували, перепилювали, вони вмирали від убивства мечем; вони блукали в овечих шкурах, у козячих шкурах, терплячи нестачу, утиски, кривди \v 38 (яких світ не був вартий), блукаючи пустелями, і горами, і печерами, і ущелинами землі.
uk.B: Їх каменували, перепилювали навпіл, убивали мечем. Вони блукали в овечих і козячих шкурах, позбавлені всього, гноблені, скривджені. \v 38 Світ не був вартий таких людей. Вони блукали пустелями й горами, ховалися в печерах і в ущелинах землі.
uk.R: Деяких убили, закидавши камінням. Деяких розпиляли пилкою навпіл. Деяких убили мечем. Деякі ходили з місця на місце, одягнені лише в шкури овець і кіз. Вони були бідні, багато страждали, і люди жорстоко з ними поводилися. \v 38 Світ не був вартий таких людей. Вони блукали пустелями й горами. Їм доводилося ховатися в печерах і в ямах у землі.

ja.L: 彼らは石で打たれ、のこぎりで引き切られ、剣によって殺されて死にました。羊の皮ややぎの皮を着て歩き回り、乏しく、苦しめられ、虐げられ、\v 38 ――この世は彼らにふさわしくありませんでした――荒れ野や山や洞穴や地の穴をさまよいました。
ja.B: 彼らは石で打ち殺され、のこぎりで二つに引かれ、剣で切り殺されました。羊ややぎの皮をまとってさまよい、あらゆるものに事欠き、苦しめられ、ひどい扱いを受けました。\v 38 この世は、このような人々にふさわしくありませんでした。彼らは荒れ野や山をさまよい、洞穴や地の穴に身を隠したのです。
ja.R: ある人たちは、石を投げつけられて殺されました。のこぎりで二つに切られた人もいました。剣で殺された人もいました。羊ややぎの皮だけを身にまとって、あちこちを渡り歩いた人もいました。彼らは貧しく、ひどく苦しみ、人々からむごい扱いを受けました。\v 38 この世は、このような人たちにふさわしくありませんでした。彼らは荒れ野や山をさまよい歩きました。ほら穴や、地面に掘った穴に隠れなければなりませんでした。

decisions.choice: the SBLGNT text: "they were stoned, they were sawn in two"
alternatives: many manuscripts add "they were tempted" (or "tested") before or after "they were sawn in two"
decisions.reason: From general knowledge: a word meaning "they were tempted" stands in many manuscripts, but in different places, and some early witnesses lack it. A word for "tempted" seems out of place among ways of being killed, and it looks very like the words for "sawn" and "burned" in Greek, so it may have come from a copying slip. The SBLGNT leaves it out. Reviewers must check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: 2 Chronicles 24:20-22; 1 Kings 19:10; Jeremiah 26:20-23
decisions.reason: Zechariah son of Jehoiada was stoned in the temple court (2 Chronicles 24:20-22; Matthew 23:35). Being sawn in two is not told in the Old Testament; an old Jewish tradition, found in the Ascension of Isaiah, says that Isaiah was sawn in two under King Manasseh. Prophets were killed with the sword (1 Kings 19:10; Jeremiah 26:23).

μηλωτή is the word the Greek Old Testament uses for Elijah's cloak (1 Kings 19:13, 19; 2 Kings 2:13-14); Elijah wore a garment of hair (2 Kings 1:8). Rough skins were the clothing of the poor and of prophets (Zechariah 13:4).

decisions.choice: "of whom the world was not worthy" is a comment set into the description
decisions.reason: The relative clause breaks into the list of participles ("being mistreated ... wandering"). It turns the world's judgment around: those the world drove out were too good for it.

decisions.choice: 1 Kings 18:4, 13; 19:9; 1 Maccabees 2:28-31; 2 Maccabees 6:11
decisions.reason: Obadiah hid a hundred prophets in caves (1 Kings 18:4, 13), Elijah lodged in a cave (1 Kings 19:9), and in the Maccabean persecution faithful Jews fled to the mountains and hid in caves (1 Maccabees 2:28-31; 2 Maccabees 6:11).

decisions.choice: mistreated: the same kind of suffering Moses chose to share (11:25)
decisions.reason: κακουχέομαι is the simple form of the verb used in 11:25 (συγκακουχέομαι, "to be mistreated together with"); it appears again in 13:3.

decisions.choice: killed by having stones thrown at them; cut in two with a saw; killed with swords
alternatives: stoned; sawn in two; died by the sword
decisions.reason: Readable explains each form of death in plain words and adds "some", since not all suffered every one.

decisions.choice: The comment "of whom the world was not worthy" set off with "――" (L)
decisions.reason: The English Literal uses parentheses; Japanese marks an inserted comment with the dash pair, and Balanced and Readable make it a sentence of its own.

source.text: καὶ πάντες μαρτυρηθέντες διὰ τῆς πίστεως οὐκ ἐκομίσαντο τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν, τοῦ θεοῦ περὶ ἡμῶν κρεῖττόν τι προβλεψαμένου, ἵνα μὴ χωρὶς ἡμῶν τελειωθῶσιν.

records.literal_gloss: And these all having been attested through the faith not received the promise, \v 40 the God for us something better having foreseen, so that not apart from us they would be made perfect.

en.L: And all these, having been attested through faith, did not receive the promise, \v 40 God having foreseen something better for us, so that they would not be made perfect apart from us.
en.B: Through their faith all of these were attested by God, and yet they did not receive the promise. \v 40 God had in view something better for us: they were not to be made perfect apart from us.
en.R: God approved of all these people because of their faith. But none of them received what God had promised. \v 40 God had planned something better that would include us. They will not be made complete without us. We will reach the goal together.

es.L: Y todos estos, habiendo recibido testimonio por medio de la fe, no obtuvieron la promesa, \v 40 habiendo previsto Dios algo mejor para nosotros, para que no fueran hechos perfectos aparte de nosotros.
es.B: Por su fe, todos estos recibieron la aprobación de Dios, y sin embargo no obtuvieron la promesa. \v 40 Dios tenía en vista algo mejor para nosotros: ellos no habían de ser hechos perfectos sin nosotros.
es.R: Dios aprobó a todas estas personas por su fe. Pero ninguna de ellas recibió lo que Dios había prometido. \v 40 Dios había planeado algo mejor que nos incluiría a nosotros. Ellos no llegarán a estar completos sin nosotros. Llegaremos juntos a la meta.

fr.L: Et tous ceux-là, ayant reçu un témoignage par la foi, n’obtinrent pas la promesse, \v 40 Dieu ayant prévu pour nous quelque chose de meilleur, afin qu’ils ne soient pas rendus parfaits en dehors de nous.
fr.B: Par leur foi, tous ceux-là reçurent le témoignage de Dieu, et pourtant ils n’obtinrent pas la promesse. \v 40 Dieu avait prévu pour nous quelque chose de meilleur : ils ne devaient pas être rendus parfaits sans nous.
fr.R: Dieu a approuvé tous ces gens à cause de leur foi. Mais aucun d’eux n’a reçu ce que Dieu avait promis. \v 40 Dieu avait prévu quelque chose de meilleur, qui nous inclurait nous aussi. Ils ne seront pas complets sans nous. Nous arriverons au but ensemble.

sw.L: Na hawa wote, wakiwa wameshuhudiwa kupitia imani, hawakupokea ahadi, \v 40 Mungu akiwa ameona mbele kitu kilicho bora zaidi kwa ajili yetu, ili wao wasikamilishwe bila sisi.
sw.B: Kupitia imani yao hawa wote walishuhudiwa na Mungu, lakini bado hawakupokea ahadi. \v 40 Mungu alikuwa amekusudia kitu kilicho bora zaidi kwa ajili yetu: wao hawakupaswa kukamilishwa bila sisi.
sw.R: Mungu aliwakubali watu hawa wote kwa sababu ya imani yao. Lakini hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyepokea kile ambacho Mungu alikuwa ameahidi. \v 40 Mungu alikuwa amepanga kitu kilicho bora zaidi ambacho kingetuhusisha sisi pia. Hawatakamilika bila sisi. Tutafikia lengo pamoja.

vi.L: Và tất cả những người này, dù đã được chứng nhận nhờ đức tin, vẫn chưa nhận được lời hứa, \v 40 vì Đức Chúa Trời đã định sẵn một điều tốt hơn cho chúng ta, để họ không được làm cho trọn vẹn mà không có chúng ta.
vi.B: Tất cả những người này đều được Đức Chúa Trời chứng nhận nhờ đức tin của họ, thế mà họ vẫn chưa nhận được điều đã hứa. \v 40 Vì Đức Chúa Trời đã dự định một điều tốt hơn cho chúng ta: họ sẽ không được làm cho trọn vẹn mà không có chúng ta.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã khen ngợi tất cả những người này vì đức tin của họ. Nhưng không ai trong họ đã nhận được điều Đức Chúa Trời hứa. \v 40 Đức Chúa Trời đã định sẵn một điều tốt hơn, có cả chúng ta trong đó. Họ sẽ không được làm cho hoàn toàn nếu không có chúng ta. Chúng ta sẽ cùng nhau đến đích.

ko.L: 그리고 이 사람들은 모두 믿음으로 인정을 받았지만, 약속된 것을 받지 못하였습니다. \v 40 하나님께서 우리를 위하여 더 나은 것을 미리 내다보셨으니, 우리 없이는 그들이 완전하게 되지 못하게 하려는 것이었습니다.
ko.B: 이 사람들은 모두 믿음으로 하나님께 인정을 받았지만, 약속된 것을 받지 못했습니다. \v 40 하나님께서는 우리를 위하여 더 나은 것을 마련해 두셨습니다. 그들이 우리와 떨어져서는 완전하게 되지 않게 하신 것입니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 이 모든 사람을 그들의 믿음 때문에 인정하셨습니다. 그러나 그들 가운데 아무도 하나님께서 약속하신 것을 받지 못했습니다. \v 40 하나님께서는 우리도 함께 누릴 더 좋은 것을 계획해 두셨습니다. 그들은 우리 없이는 온전하게 되지 않을 것입니다. 우리는 함께 목표에 이를 것입니다.

pt.L: E todos estes, tendo recebido testemunho por meio da fé, não obtiveram a promessa, \v 40 tendo Deus previsto algo melhor para nós, para que eles não fossem aperfeiçoados sem nós.
pt.B: Por meio da fé, todos esses receberam o testemunho de Deus e, mesmo assim, não receberam a promessa. \v 40 Deus tinha em vista algo melhor para nós: eles não deviam chegar à perfeição sem nós.
pt.R: Deus aprovou todas essas pessoas por causa da fé que tinham. Mas nenhuma delas recebeu o que Deus tinha prometido. \v 40 Deus tinha planejado algo melhor, que incluiria a nós também. Eles não vão ficar completos sem nós. Vamos chegar juntos ao objetivo.

am.L: እነዚህ ሁሉ በእምነት ምስክርነት ቢያገኙም፣ ተስፋውን አልተቀበሉም፤ \v 40 እግዚአብሔር ለእኛ የተሻለ ነገር አስቀድሞ ተመልክቶ ነበርና፤ ይኸውም ከእኛ ተለይተው ፍጹማን እንዳይሆኑ ነው።
am.B: እነዚህ ሁሉ በእምነታቸው ከእግዚአብሔር ምስክርነትን አገኙ፤ ቢሆንም ተስፋውን አልተቀበሉም። \v 40 እግዚአብሔር ለእኛ የተሻለ ነገር አቅዶ ነበርና፤ እነርሱ ከእኛ ተለይተው ፍጹማን አይሆኑም።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር እነዚህን ሰዎች ሁሉ በእምነታቸው ምክንያት ተቀበላቸው። ነገር ግን ከእነርሱ አንዱም እግዚአብሔር የሰጠውን ተስፋ አልተቀበለም። \v 40 እግዚአብሔር እኛንም የሚጨምር የተሻለ ነገር አቅዶ ነበር። እነርሱ ያለ እኛ ፍጹማን አይሆኑም። አብረን ወደ ግቡ እንደርሳለን።

hi.L: और विश्वास के द्वारा इन सब की गवाही दी गई, फिर भी उन्हें प्रतिज्ञा की हुई वस्तु न मिली, \v 40 क्योंकि परमेश्वर ने हमारे लिए पहले से कुछ उत्तम ठहराया था, ताकि वे हमारे बिना सिद्ध न किए जाएँ।
hi.B: इन सब के विश्वास के कारण परमेश्वर ने उनकी गवाही दी, फिर भी उन्हें वह नहीं मिला जिसकी प्रतिज्ञा की गई थी। \v 40 परमेश्वर ने हमारे लिए कुछ उत्तम सोच रखा था: वे हमारे बिना सिद्ध न किए जाते।
hi.R: परमेश्वर ने इन सब लोगों को उनके विश्वास के कारण स्वीकार किया। पर उनमें से किसी को वह नहीं मिला जिसकी परमेश्वर ने प्रतिज्ञा की थी। \v 40 परमेश्वर ने कुछ बढ़कर सोच रखा था जिसमें हम भी शामिल हैं। वे हमारे बिना पूरी तरह योग्य नहीं बनाए जाएँगे। हम सब मिलकर लक्ष्य तक पहुँचेंगे।

ru.L: И все эти, засвидетельствованные через веру, не получили обетования, \v 40 так как Бог предусмотрел для нас нечто лучшее, чтобы они не достигли совершенства без нас.
ru.B: Все они получили от Бога свидетельство через свою веру, и всё же не получили обещанного. \v 40 Бог предусмотрел для нас нечто лучшее: они не должны были достичь совершенства без нас.
ru.R: Бог одобрил всех этих людей за их веру. Но никто из них не получил того, что обещал Бог. \v 40 Бог задумал нечто лучшее, что включает и нас. Они не станут совершенными без нас. Мы достигнем цели вместе.

uk.L: І всі вони, засвідчені через віру, не отримали обітниці, \v 40 бо Бог передбачив для нас щось краще, щоб вони не стали досконалими без нас.
uk.B: Усі вони вірою отримали Боже свідчення, а проте не одержали обітниці. \v 40 Бог мав на думці для нас щось краще: вони не мали стати досконалими без нас.
uk.R: Бог схвалив усіх цих людей через їхню віру. Але жоден із них не отримав того, що Бог обіцяв. \v 40 Бог задумав щось краще, у що ввійдемо й ми. Вони не стануть досконалими без нас. Ми досягнемо мети разом.

ja.L: そして、これらの人々は皆、信仰によって証しされましたが、約束[のもの]を受けませんでした。\v 40 神は、わたしたちのために、さらに良いものを前もって備えておられたからです。それは、わたしたちを抜きにしては、彼らが完全な者とされないためでした。
ja.B: これらの人々は皆、その信仰によって神に認められましたが、約束されたものを受けませんでした。\v 40 神は、わたしたちのために、さらに良いものを計画しておられたのです。彼らは、わたしたちと一緒でなければ、完全な者とされないのです。
ja.R: 神は、これらの人々の信仰を見て、彼らを認めてくださいました。しかし、神が約束してくださったものを受けた人は、一人もいませんでした。\v 40 神は、わたしたちも加えた、もっと良い計画を立てておられたのです。彼らは、わたしたちと一緒でなければ、完全な者になることはありません。わたしたちは共に、そのゴールにたどり着くのです。

decisions.choice: all these were attested: God's witness, as in 11:2
decisions.reason: The chapter ends as it began (11:2) with the verb "attested": God's witness to their faith, recorded in Scripture.

decisions.choice: the promise: the final inheritance God promised, not yet given
decisions.reason: They received particular promises (11:33), but not "the promise": the eternal inheritance (9:15), the heavenly city (11:10, 16), the rest God promised (4:1). This is the promise the readers must endure to receive (10:36).

decisions.choice: foreseen, provided: God planned in advance
decisions.reason: προβλέπομαι means to see beforehand and so to plan or provide. God's plan included something better that would come with the new covenant (7:19, 22; 8:6).

decisions.choice: made perfect: brought to the goal, the full salvation of the new covenant, together with Christ's people
decisions.reason: As at 2:10, to be "made perfect" means to be brought to the goal. Christ "has perfected for all time those who are being made holy" by his one offering (10:14), and in 12:23 the author speaks of "the spirits of the righteous made perfect". The faithful of old reach that goal only with those who believe in Christ, through what he has done.

decisions.choice: made complete; reach the goal
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "made perfect". Readable says "made complete", as the book allows, because "perfect" in everyday English suggests being without fault rather than being brought to the goal.

decisions.choice: attested by God; God approved of
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God as the one who bore witness (see 11:2).

decisions.choice: hechos perfectos (L, B); completos (R)
decisions.reason: As in English, Literal and Balanced keep the book's word "perfect". Readable says "completos", since "perfecto" in everyday Spanish suggests being without fault, while m4 means being brought to the goal.

decisions.choice: "सिद्ध किए जाएँ" (L, B); "पूरी तरह योग्य ... बनाए जाएँगे" (R)
decisions.reason: Key term through Hebrews, as in 2:10 and 10:14.

decisions.choice: "完全な者とされる" (L, B), "完全な者になる" and "ゴールにたどり着く" (R) for teleioō
decisions.reason: The same verb as in 2:10 and 10:14, kept as "完全な者"; Readable adds the picture of reaching the goal, as the English Readable does.
